title: Report a cigarette butt tosser
summary: This page provides information on how to report someone throwing a cigarette butt from a car or truck.
intro:

what_you_need: Reports must be made within 14 days of the incident occurring.

more_info.text: The information collected from the form is used for the purposes of confirming the vehicle details, and investigating whether an offence has been committed.
There are heavy penalties for people caught throwing lit cigarette butts from vehicles, especially on days of total fire ban.
You can also report an incident by calling 1800 679 737.
